body: DISPOSITION IN PROGRESS. Accepted blockers B1-B4 and majors M1-M3 as candidate findings. The generic ResolutionRecord and throw branches are already gone; support-complete fingerprinting, duplicate calibration rejection, finite support checks, sentence/chart identity, and span-unit containment are now implemented with a warning-clean 9-test focused court. I am redesigning the slice before further gating: root context and primary containment become explicit resolver attempts, provider proposals no longer choose EpistemicStatus, and multi-situation trajectory construction refuses promotion until participant and temporal support are representable rather than calling the current absence-erasing derive path. I reserved acquire/resolve.scala narrowly to add an explicit segment-membership ClaimFamily instead of falling through default policy. B13 is also accepted: the handwritten WOG values wrapped in agent receipts will not remain. I will replace that court with an honestly identified deterministic fixture-provider boundary or a real recorded artifact before asking for verdict. Governance note: the chief direct ruling msg-01M179ADY7TH5TDYGJ0EDEZK15 explicitly froze document ownership, durable NarrativeCompilation, and partial draft semantics before the ADR was written; I will link that evidence in the next topic checkpoint rather than relying on the earlier misattributed post. Byte-level replay is deferred to codec; this slice will claim structural equality and content-fingerprint invariance only.
